_comment: Config for routing_audit — the deterministic gate for step 7 (PCB Routing). Read-only: parses the .kicad_pcb tracks/vias and asserts each net's copper obeys its net-class width, routing is complete (no unrouted nets), tracks keep off the board edge, and corners are 45deg not 90. Net->class resolution is reused from route_pcb_simple (patterns + class widths from the .kicad_pro) so the gate agrees with the router. All dynamic — net class is derived from the actual net name via the project's patterns, never a per-circuit list. Cached; RESTART backend after edits. Verdict in words.
_rule_source: Master flow step 7 (PCB Routing) automation checks + PCB_RULES routing section.

unrouted_nets._rule: Rule 7 — when a board has tracks (routing started/finished), every multi-pad net must have copper. A net with >=2 pads and no track/via is unrouted (ratsnest). A wholly-unrouted board reports NOT ROUTED instead of spamming one error per net.

track_width_vs_class._rule: Rules 1/3 — every track segment must be >= its net's net-class width (resolved via .kicad_pro netclass_patterns + classes) and the board min_track_width. A power net on a thin default track is a flag.

track_edge_clearance._rule: Rule 6 — no track may run within the copper-to-edge clearance of the Edge.Cuts outline.

corner_90._rule: Rule 5 — 45deg or curved corners, never 90. Two same-net same-layer segments meeting at a vertex within corner_tol_deg of a right angle are flagged.

verdict.clean: ROUTING VERIFIED — {n} nets routed, widths/corners/edge OK
verdict.no_tracks: NOT ROUTED — board has no tracks yet ({t} nets to route)
